name: antigravity-agy-proxy
description: Independent enhanced proxy & resilience extension for Antigravity IDE Remote-SSH (v2.6.0+ agy & legacy language servers), featuring UDP/FD leak prevention, SSH keepalive, crontab FD guard, and auto-troubleshooting.

antigravity-agy-proxy.enableLocalForward.description: Use local proxy via SSH tunnel. If true, the extension will manage ~/.ssh/config.antigravity and forward the remote port to your local machine.

antigravity-agy-proxy.localProxyPort.description: Local proxy port on your computer (e.g., 7890 for Clash). Only used when enableLocalForwarding is true.

antigravity-agy-proxy.remoteProxyHost.description: The host address on the remote server where the proxy is reachable. Use 127.0.0.1 when enableLocalForwarding is true.

antigravity-agy-proxy.remoteProxyPort.description: The port on the remote server that should be used as the proxy gateway.

antigravity-agy-proxy.showStatusOnStartu.description: Show a status notification when connecting to a remote server. Displays proxy status and whether reload is needed.

enumDescriptions: HTTP proxy (recommended for most proxy software like Clash, V2Ray)
SOCKS5H proxy (remote DNS resolution via proxy, helpful when local DNS is polluted)
antigravity-agy-proxy.proxyType.description: The proxy protocol type. Choose HTTP for most proxy software (Clash, V2Ray, etc), or SOCKS5/SOCKS5H if using SOCKS5.

enumDescriptions: TCP ptrace proxy via mgraftcp with FakeDNS disabled (--disable-fakedns). Recommended: intercepts non-proxy-aware traffic without leaking UDP sockets.
Pure proxy environment variables (HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/ALL_PROXY). Zero ptrace overhead and zero UDP FakeDNS sockets.
TCP ptrace proxy with FakeDNS + CGO DNS. Use only if server DNS is polluted and DNS cannot resolve directly.
antigravity-agy-proxy.proxyMode.description: How traffic interception is applied to agy / language_server on the remote host.

antigravity-agy-proxy.enableFdGuard.description: Automatically maintain a rootless crontab guard that kills runaway agy.bak / language_server_linux*.bak processes exceeding fdGuardThreshold open file descriptors.

antigravity-agy-proxy.fdGuardThreshold.description: Open FD count threshold above which the FD Guard crontab terminates agy.bak / language_server_linux*.bak.

antigravity-agy-proxy.fdGuardIntervalMin.description: How often (in minutes) the FD Guard cron job inspects open file descriptors.

antigravity-agy-proxy.autoFixOnStartup.description: Automatically remediate runaway FD leaks, FakeDNS bind failures, and protocol/mode mismatches when connecting to remote hosts.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
